title: chore(governance): the human-merge line threshold is 3,000 changed lines (HUMAN_MERGE_LINE_THRESHOLD), per the maintainer's 2026-10-09 ruling
body:
Fixes #22451
Clause-②: no

## Summary

The maintainer, 2026-10-09, verbatim and untranslated: 「这种大额改动就应该人工审核,我还是建议5000行的人工审核门槛降到 3000,立卡。」

`HUMAN_MERGE_LINE_THRESHOLD` moves from 5000 to 3000 changed lines (`additions + deletions`, generated files included). It stays declared ONCE, in `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`; the predicate stays STRICTLY greater (exactly 3,000 is under, 3,001 is over). Nothing else about the rule changes: the four-piece terminal set, no Tier S exception, generated files included, the per-repo coverage of `GOVERNED_REPOS`. The earlier maintainer quotes (2026-09-18 and 2026-09-27) stay verbatim everywhere they were; the 2026-10-09 words are added beside them, verbatim. No ADR records the number (`git grep` over `docs/adr/**` and `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`: zero hits on the threshold), so no ADR amendment is owed.

Lineage recorded on the card: 2026-09-18 「修改代码量超过某个行数(比如5000)就应该人工审核」; 2026-09-27 「所以阈值写死成 5000 行 , 维护者已经批准了就是可以合并。」; 2026-10-09 the words above. PR #22215 (the occasion) is unaffected: no retroactive review of anything already approved or merged.

Notation in this body: the greater-than sign is spelled `[over]` wherever a source line carries it, because the platform's body sanitizer eats angle-bracket-shaped fragments.

### Readers that follow the constant unchanged (PM hypothesis 1, measured on this head)

### The literal pin over the seven touched files

`git grep -n -E '\b500[01]\b|5,000'` on `cfff9b1a` over the seven files: 23 hits, every one a quoted maintainer ruling, a parse-only probe, or one regex artifact —

- quoted rulings, verbatim and untouched: `check-governed-merges.mjs:187` (2026-09-18), `:191` and `:1106` (2026-10-09, the words added), `:260` (2026-09-27), `:1103` (the 「比如5000」 fragment the docblock always quoted); `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:333`, `:337`, `:392`, `:1867`, `:1911`, `:1912`, `:1913`, `:3464`, `:3465`, `:3466`, `:3553`; `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:324` (the 2026-09-18 quote);
- parse-only probes, unchanged on purpose: `check-governed-merges.mjs:6003` (a string `'5001'` is NOT MEASURED), `:6107` / `:6109` (`--additions 5000 --deletions 1` parse as the pair with the CALLER as source), `:6196` (half a pair, `--additions 5001` alone, is refused);

No prose restatement outside a quote carries the old figure any more.

## The measurement the card asks for: merged pull requests of the last 30 days between 3,001 and 5,000 changed lines

**Window and filter, stated exactly.** Repository `objectstack-ai/objectstack` only. Window: `merged_at` in [2026-09-09T12:16:51Z, 2026-10-09T12:16:51Z] (30 days back from the reading, taken at 2026-10-09T12:16:51Z). Source: `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls?state=closed&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=100`, paged until a page's oldest `updated_at` fell before the window start (27 pages, 2,700 closed pull requests read; a merge inside the window implies `updated_at` at or after it, so no later page can hold one); then one `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls/{n}` per candidate for `additions` / `deletions` (the list object omits them). Changed lines = `additions + deletions` as GitHub reports them, generated files included — the same number the predicate reads. ⛔ This is a reading of one window in one repository, not a claim about every pull request ever merged; objectui and cloud are not in it.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
把「超过多少行就必须人工审核」这条线从 5000 行降到 3000 行(additions + deletions,含生成物)。数字只在 `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` 里声明一次,队列守卫、派发脚本、自检、技能文件与 `AGENTS.md` 都跟着这一处读;自检的钉子同步挪到 3000/3001;三条早前的原话原样保留,10 月 9 日的原话加在旁边。

### 为什么改
按维护者 2026-10-09 的裁决原话执行:「这种大额改动就应该人工审核,我还是建议5000行的人工审核门槛降到 3000,立卡。」 字面已给定,不是决策卡。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
- 代价:落地后,3001–5000 行之间的 PR 从「绿了就能排队合并」变成「要维护者 APPROVED(或人工直合)才能落地」。本 PR 正文的 30 天实测给出了这个区间的 PR 数量,即新增的审核负担。
- 风险:低。规则其余部分一字未动(四件套、无 Tier S 例外、含生成物、各仓覆盖)。`dispatch-gates.mjs` 冻结文件只动了那一枚因常量搬家而必红的钉子。
